rationale: The request explicitly describes workflow-level obstruction caused by a required approval constraint and selects Review mode. The executor performed only corroborated read-only inspection, and the fixture hash and contents remained unchanged. The response supplies prioritized findings, distinguishes requester-provided approval information from directly observed fixture state and derived risks, identifies material open decisions, and keeps each recommendation tied to an individual finding without defining a coordinated end-to-end workflow, state model, or ownership structure. The explicit Review mode label is correctly visible. Coverage of recovery, retained context, approval handoff/ownership, authoritative records, and unchanged state is relevant and proportionate; no unsupported real-world validation is claimed.
